blocks.text: VOCs organic compounds ka bara group hain jo kamre ke darja hararat par aasani se bhaap bante hain aur kuch solids ya liquids se gases ke taur par kharij hote hain. Liquid fuels bahar ki hawa par asar dalne wale bare zaraye hain; gariyon ka exhaust aur liquid fossil fuels, lakri aur koora jalana sab VOCs chhorte hain. Thori der ka samna aankh, naak aur gale ki jalan, sar dard aur matli deta hai; lambe arse ka samna jigar, gurdon aur markazi aasabi nizam ko nuqsan deta hai. Yeh andar aur bahar dono ki aaloodgi mein hissa dalte hain; aam VOCs benzene, xylene, toluene, ethanol, formaldehyde aur acetone hain.

blocks.prompt: VOCs hawa ke mayar par kaise asar dalte hain (Quick Check 14.2c)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh fuels, solvents aur jalti lakri ya koore se hawa mein bhaap bante hain, jahan seedhe aankhon aur saans ki naliyon ko jalate hain aur, dhoop mein nitrogen oxides ke saath, photochemical smog ki ozone aur PAN banate hain; lamba samna jigar, gurdon aur aasabi nizam ko nuqsan deta hai.

items: VOCs aasani se bhaap bante hain (benzene, xylene, toluene, ethanol, formaldehyde, acetone) fuels, exhausts, lakri aur koore se; thori der mein jalan aur matli, lambe arse mein jigar, gurde aur aasabi nuqsan; andar aur bahar ki aaloodgi.
